To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of sulfur dyes and/or vat dyes in combination with mercapto compounds, sulfur compounds and sulfite salt compounds in the dyeing of textile materials results in more satisfactory dyeing.

1) sulfur dyes are the most efficient and cost effective dyes for cotton dyeing, and 2) sulfur dyes have been shown to be the most efficient and environmentally friendly dyeing option for cotton dyeing.

the use of a mercapto compound or an organic sulfur compound in dye baths, or the use of a sulfite salt in the dye bath, or the use, together, of both a mercapto or an organic sulfur and a sulfite salt, in dye baths, can bring about improved dyeing results in the dyeing of textile materials with sulfur dyes and/or sulfurized vat dies, especially when such dye baths are used in dyeing textile materials of cotton, linen, hemp
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new and improved processes for the production of dyes and intermediates.
the development of a new generation of materials that are capable of sensing and reacting to their surroundings.
the study of the chemical, physical, and biological processes that control the formation and fate of organic compounds in the environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of the mercapto compound or sulfur compound, or a combination thereof, in the dyeing of textile materials, particularly in the dyeing thereof with sulfur dyes, or sulfurized vat or vat dyes, or with vat dyes, produces dyeings having improved fastness to washing and light.
the use of a mercapto compound, an organic sulfur compound and a sulfite salt in the dyeing of textile materials with a sulfur dye or a vat dye is a highly desirable procedure.
, in general, it is not necessary to use a sulfite salt to obtain good dyeing results with sulfur dyes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the C library is not thread-safe and we should not use it in a multi-threaded environment.

the dyeing process of textile materials with sulfur dyes and/or sulfurized vat dyles is more satisfactorily accomplished by allowing an organic sulfide compound and/or an organo mercapto compound to be present in the dye baths.

the dyeing results with sulfur dyes and sulfurized vat dypes were improved when the dye baths contained mercapto compounds and/or organic sulfur compounds and/or a sulfite salt, and that the dyeing with the sulfur dyes and/or the vat dyes was further improved when a sulfite salt was further present
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of the C libraries is not only safe, but it also provides a way to improve the quality of the C libraries, and it also provides a better way to use the C libraries.
the C library ecosystem is not yet prepared for multi-threaded execution, and we should be cautious about using it in such a way.
it is possible to use sulfur dyes in the presence of mercapto compounds to dye textile materials, such as fibers and cloths, more satisfactorily than by using sulfur dyes alone.
